> 第二十章 疯狂女友（第1页）
看台上三位黑魔法师的交流，绝对不是下面那些学徒们能够揣度的。
在结束自己的战斗后，塞恩与鲍斯移步高级学徒们的战斗区域，近距离观察高级学徒们的战斗过程。
“嘿，塞恩，我在这里。”当戴着苍白假面的塞恩出现在高级学徒区域时，他的师姐菲儿向他招了招手。
师姐菲儿的战斗已经结束，由于掌握的是暴烈无匹的火元素魔法，加之又有摩西多大师和佐罗师兄赠予的不少魔法道具，菲儿师姐的名次已经锁定前三。
倒是塞恩女友莉娜，以及与塞恩有过一次接触的莉莉安雅，她们俩的战斗还未结束。
此时高级学徒圈子中已经决出两个名额，她们在争夺最后一个。
莉娜的对手，是一个掌握罕见练尸合成兽的学徒。
从这个学徒的身上，塞恩看到了正式黑魔法师科索隆大师的几分影子。
除了他面前的召唤物，是一个集结了数种魔兽躯体与头颅的扭曲怪物之外，就连该学徒本身也有四只手臂，看的直教人遍体生寒。
不过更令人恶寒的，是这名高级学徒的脖颈处长了一枚红色的肉瘤。
如同心脏般缓缓地跳动声自肉瘤中传出，仿佛在孕育着什么东西。
高级学徒们的战斗手段与战斗方式，要超过了中、低级学徒不止一筹。
不仅自身掌握的魔法多达数种，甚至是十几种，包括各方各面的底牌也层出不穷。
譬如那个肉瘤学徒，除了拥有一头扭曲怪物作为打手之外，他自身还拥有一些类似死亡射线的特殊手段。
包括那个肉瘤学徒身后披着的灰色披风，似乎也是一件品级不低的魔法装备。
反观莉娜，除了塞恩较为熟悉的那串黑晶石手链之外，她手头多出的唯一一件魔法装备，是她手腕部位的一枚黑色镯轮。
除此之外，莉娜比两个月前，似乎多掌握了另外两门暗元素魔法，一种是从手指释放的射线，还有一种是暗能量球。
作为一名晋升高级学徒还足半年的新人，莉娜此战要想取胜恐怕很难。

“你的那个小女友实力不错嘛，能把死亡之手迈克逼到这个份上，我原先以为战斗会很快结束呢。”菲儿师姐笑着说道。
作为高级学徒，其实早在年级考核开始前，彼此大概就知道谁能获得什么名次。
死亡之手迈克无疑是学院高级学徒中的佼佼者，除了他本身掌握的死亡系魔法不俗之外，那头不畏疼痛的合成兽怪物，也是个棘手货色。
按理说，高级学徒的前三名，最后一个席位基本是锁定于迈克身上了。
但现在的情况，显然对于迈克来讲并没有稳操胜券。
面对师姐菲儿的调笑，塞恩刚想说些什么，不过关注到场上变化的他，却是猛然面色一变。
果然莉娜在中级学徒时被称为‘疯女人’，哪怕到了高级学徒圈子她也没有变化太多。
死亡之手迈克与自己的练尸合成兽近远程交替配合，莉娜想要按照常规手法拿下对方，显然是太难了。
不过莉娜并不是一个轻言放弃的人，一手暴烈火球凝聚，另一手浓郁的暗元素光辉在她的晶石项链处聚集。
两道魔法同时就绪的情况，令死亡之手迈克也不禁提起神来。
但令所有人都没想到的是，两道魔法光辉出现后，莉娜并没有选择立即释放它们，而是手腕部的镯轮一闪，她本人竟是化为一道速度极快的暗影朝着迈克近身逼去！
“什么？！”不止有一个魔法学徒在注意到这一情景后，不禁叫了出来。
包括看台上的三个黑魔法师，此时也将注意力视线投了过来。
其中一人可能是想缓解一下刚才安迪斯释放的冷冽敌意，只见他说道：“竟然同时释放两道魔法，不，准确来说应该是三道。”
“虽然有借助两件魔法道具的嫌疑，但她的精神力精炼程度和对魔力的细微操控着实不错。”这名黑魔法师赞叹道。

The latest chapter of Lord of Ash_Chapter 20 Crazy Girlfriend Page 1_Lord of Ash I love Xiaodou_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 20 Crazy Girlfriend (Page 1)
The exchanges between the three black magicians in the stands were definitely not something that the apprentices below could fathom.
After finishing their own battle, Thain and Boss moved to the battle area where the senior apprentices were fighting to observe the battle process of the senior apprentices at close range.
"Hey, Thain, I'm here." When Thain, wearing a pale mask, appeared in the senior apprentice area, his senior sister Feier waved to him.
The battle for senior sister Fei'er has ended. Due to her mastery of the extremely violent fire element magic and the many magic props given by Master Mosheduo and senior brother Zorro, senior sister Fei'er's ranking has been locked in the top three.
However, the battle between Thane's girlfriend Lina and Lilianya, who had had contact with Thain, was not over yet.
At this time, two places have been decided in the senior apprentice circle, and they are competing for the last one.
Lina's opponent is an apprentice who masters a rare corpse-refining beast.
From this apprentice, Thane saw some shadows of the official black magician, Master Cosolon.
In addition to the summoned object in front of him, which is a twisted monster that combines the bodies and heads of several kinds of monsters, even the apprentice himself has four arms, which makes people feel cold all over.
But what was even more chilling was the fact that this senior apprentice had a red tumor on his neck.
A slow beating sound like a heart came from the sarcoma, as if it was pregnant with something.
The fighting methods and fighting methods of high-level apprentices are more than one step ahead of those of mid-level and low-level apprentices.
Not only does he have several or even a dozen types of magic at his disposal, but he also has an endless supply of trump cards in all aspects.
For example, the sarcoma apprentice, in addition to having a twisted monster as a thug, he also has some special means similar to death rays.
Including the gray cloak draped behind the sarcoma apprentice, it seemed to be a piece of high-grade magic equipment.
On the other hand, Lina, apart from the black spar bracelet that Thain was more familiar with, the only other magical equipment she had on hand was a black bracelet on her wrist.
In addition, Lina seems to have mastered two more dark element magics than two months ago, one is the ray released from the fingers, and the other is the dark energy ball.
As a newcomer who has only been promoted to senior apprentice for half a year, it may be difficult for Lina to win this battle.
"That little girlfriend of yours is pretty good. She was able to push Death Hand Mike to this level. I originally thought the battle would end soon." Senior Sister Fei'er said with a smile.
As senior apprentices, in fact, we probably know who will get what ranking before the grade assessment begins.
Death Hand Mike is undoubtedly the best among the advanced apprentices in the academy. In addition to his excellent command of death magic, the synthetic beast monster that is not afraid of pain is also a troublesome thing.
It stands to reason that the last seat among the top three senior apprentices is basically locked to Mike.
But the current situation clearly does not guarantee victory for Mike.
Facing senior sister Fei'er's teasing, Thain was about to say something, but when he noticed the changes on the field, his expression suddenly changed.
As expected, Lina was called a 'crazy woman' when she was an intermediate apprentice. Even in the senior apprenticeship circle, she didn't change much.
Death Hand Mike alternately cooperated with his corpse-training beast at near and long range. It was obviously too difficult for Lina to take down the opponent with conventional methods.
However, Lina was not one to give up easily. A violent fireball condensed in one hand, and the rich dark elemental light gathered in her crystal necklace in the other hand.
The fact that the two magics were ready at the same time made Death Hand Mike couldn't help but wonder.
But what no one expected was that the twoAfter the magic rays appeared, Lina did not choose to release them immediately. Instead, the bracelet on her wrist flashed, and she turned into a very fast shadow and moved towards Mike!
"What?!" More than one magic apprentice couldn't help shouting after noticing this scene.
Including the three black magicians in the stands, they also cast their attention at this time.
One of them may have wanted to alleviate the cold hostility released by Andis just now, but he said: "He actually released two magic spells at the same time, no, to be precise, it should be three."
"Although she is suspected of using two magic props, her mental refinement and subtle control of magic are really good." The black magician praised.
